description: PR86 で閉包 sha が変わった dev-graph の live-trial 受領書 5 件 (C01・C05・C14・C15・C18) を、PR85 で受理した同じ scenario のまま流し直すための scenario 契約。scenario_id・fixture・task の意味は PR85 の各 run と同じで、resource_budget と required_observations を実走の前に固定した。C02・C03・C04・C19 は plugins/dev-graph/tests/fixtures/live-trial-positive-scenarios.json を正本とし、ここには置かない。

scenarios.resource_budget_basis: 2x the PR85 measured run (20261013T0117-pr85: wall_clock_s=375, total_tokens=1.61M incl. subagents), rounded up to 300 s / 1M tokens; fixed before the re-run and never raised afterwards.
scenarios.fixture_contract: A contained plain git repository with one committed README and no dev-graph state; the same init is run twice with identical arguments.
required_observations: after the first init the six content roots, the routing policy, and the graph store exist and the initial graph passes C11
a second init with the same arguments plans 0 changes and preserves user edits
the repo config stores no absolute path, token, or node ID and the plugin hook source is used

scenarios.resource_budget_basis: 2x the PR85 measured run (20261012T2212-pr85: wall_clock_s=385, total_tokens=1.29M incl. subagents), rounded up to 300 s / 1M tokens; fixed before the re-run and never raised afterwards.
scenarios.fixture_contract: A contained repository transplanted from the accepted render seed fixture (feature LT-FEATURE-001, its exact-13 package with a registration receipt, some tasks done), rekeyed to the new repository and with the previous render output excluded.
required_observations: the generated HTML has zero external resource references and draws features, tasks, and edges as inline SVG
LT-FEATURE-001 progress X/Y matches the graph, Y equals the registration receipt expected_count, and the child task set equals the receipt node_ids
the render is invoked with the registration receipt and its target corresponds to the receipt source_digest
two consecutive renders produce identical output digests

scenarios.resource_budget_basis: 2x the PR85 measured run (20261013T0331-pr85: wall_clock_s=490, total_tokens=2.29M incl. subagents), rounded up to 300 s / 1M tokens; fixed before the re-run and never raised afterwards.
scenarios.task_args_template: <natural-language macro request adding two dependent features on top of LT-FEATURE-001 with tracker_binding beads> --repo-root <contained-fixture-repo> --dry-run
scenarios.fixture_contract: A contained repository transplanted from the accepted render seed fixture (architecture ARCH-LT-001, feature LT-FEATURE-001 with its exact-13 package), rekeyed to the new repository, with execution_tracker.mode=beads and a contained fake Beads adapter at tools/fake-bd.py; the decompose run is a macro proposal preview whose projection is checked through C28 dry-run.
required_observations: the macro feature+architecture DAG including the existing nodes is acyclic and contains no task-granularity node
every new node is a draft preview and no feature is registered directly through a plain C02 add
the binding=beads projection preview through C28 bd-bridge.py targets only confirmed/pass/readiness-complete nodes and 0 pre-evaluation draft nodes
the original graph digest is unchanged and Beads, GitHub, and Projects writes are 0

scenarios.resource_budget_basis: 2x the PR85 measured run (20261013T0456-pr85: wall_clock_s=580, total_tokens=2.09M incl. subagents), rounded up to 300 s / 1M tokens; fixed before the re-run and never raised afterwards.
scenarios.fixture_contract: A contained repository transplanted from the accepted schedule seed fixture, rekeyed to the new repository, mixing ready tasks (overlapping and disjoint resource_scope), blocked tasks, draft/unconfirmed/evaluation-non-pass/readiness-non-complete tasks, and one active lease.
required_observations: every recommended task has all depends_on satisfied (ready)
blocked, draft, unconfirmed, evaluation non-pass, and readiness non-complete tasks appear 0 times in the ready-set
no resource_scope overlaps inside a parallel batch and the active lease is respected
suggested_branch and the worktree claim command are unique per recommended task

scenarios.resource_budget_basis: 2x the PR85 measured run (20261012T2229-pr85: wall_clock_s=775, total_tokens=3.91M incl. subagents and the in-trial init/node preparation), rounded up to 300 s / 1M tokens; fixed before the re-run and never raised afterwards.
scenarios.fixture_contract: A contained plain git repository that the trial initializes with the canonical init and populates through the C02 single writer (task-lt-task-001 with depends_on and a meaningful closed_at) before the status run.
required_observations: the reported status, closed_at, and depends_on of task-lt-task-001 match the graph store values
C11 validate-graph-schema exits 0 on the queried graph
the graph digest is unchanged across the status run and GitHub/Beads writes are 0
